name: Fire Rated Doors
title: Fire Rated Doors Manufacturer in India
paragraphs: Anjali Doors Pvt. Ltd. is a fire rated door manufacturer in India, manufacturing certified steel doors for industrial, commercial and infrastructure projects. Our fire rated doors are built using galvanized steel with mineral wool or ceramic wool insulation and are available with fire resistance of up to 3 hours.

Designed for areas where controlling the spread of fire, heat and smoke is critical, these doors are suitable for factories, hospitals, pharmaceutical facilities, warehouses, commercial buildings, electrical rooms and other fire-sensitive areas. Our fire rated doors are tested by ARAI and manufactured to meet applicable BS 476 and IS 3614 requirements. Custom sizes, single and double-leaf configurations, finishes and compatible hardware options are available according to project requirements.

Fire rated doors are engineered door assemblies designed to resist the passage of fire, heat and smoke for a specified period. When installed at designated fire barriers and compartment openings, they help limit the movement of fire from one area of a building to another and support safer evacuation during an emergency.

Unlike a conventional steel door, a fire rated door is constructed with fire-resistant materials and designed as part of a complete door assembly, including the shutter, frame, insulation and suitable hardware. Depending on the project requirement, Anjali Doors can manufacture steel fire rated doors in different sizes and configurations for industrial and commercial applications.

Our emergency exit doors are engineered for durability, safety, and long-term performance.

name: Window and Door Fitting
title: Window & Door Fitting Services in India
paragraphs: Anjali Doors Pvt. Ltd. provides professional window and door fitting services for residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure projects. Our installation team handles steel doors, metal windows, industrial door systems and compatible frames and hardware with attention to alignment, fixing and smooth operation.

Whether the requirement is for a new construction project, replacement installation or project-specific door and window fitting, the work is carried out according to the opening condition and installation requirements. Accurate fitting helps the installed door or window operate correctly and supports dependable long-term performance.

Window and door fitting is the process of positioning, aligning, fixing and adjusting a door or window system within the prepared opening. Proper fitting includes checking the frame position, clearances, fixing points, hardware and final operation so the installed unit functions as intended.

The fitting requirements can vary according to the door or window type, opening condition, frame construction, hardware and building application. For steel doors and metal windows in particular, accurate positioning and secure fixing are important for reliable day-to-day operation.

Industrial metal fabrication is the process of converting metal sheets, plates, sections or pipes into usable components and structures. Depending on the project, the process can involve cutting, bending, drilling, welding, assembly and surface finishing.
The correct process and material depend on the component design, operating environment, required strength, dimensions and finishing requirements.
